context_requirements: Functional reduced folate carrier (SLC19A1/RFC) for hydrophilic antifolate uptake
Active folate-dependent one-carbon metabolism and nucleotide biosynthesis
Proliferating cells with intact DNA damage and p53/p21 checkpoint signaling for cytostatic transcriptional response
Adequate intracellular polyglutamation capacity (FPGS) for retention of classical antifolates
falsifiers: No induction of p53 targets (CDKN1A, GADD45A, MDM2, BBC3) at 24 h in any line
No suppression of S-phase or G2/M cell-cycle genes (e.g., PCNA, MCM3, CCNB1, CDK1) at 24 h
No change in one-carbon metabolism genes (MTHFD2, SHMT2, TYMS, DHFR) at either time
Transcriptional responses indistinguishable from vehicle across all nine lines at both 6 and 24 h
Strong interferon or unfolded protein response signature without cell-cycle or p53-related changes

evidence.supports: Pralatrexate, a DHFR inhibitor, is taken up by the reduced folate carrier and inhibits growth of lymphoma lines, supporting DHFR inhibition as the mechanism.
Pyrimethamine, a DHFR inhibitor, promotes ROS-associated apoptosis in MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells.
Pyrimethamine, a DHFR inhibitor, has cytotoxic effects on MCF-7 breast cancer cells.
Methotrexate, a DHFR inhibitor, induces apoptosis in human CaSki cervical cancer cells.
PT523, a potent DHFR inhibitor, requires reduced folate carrier for uptake, and resistance arises via RFC loss.
